evals.prompt: Define state-machine-modeling in 2-3 sentences. Include the work it owns and the kind of user request that should activate it.
Explain why an agent would need the state-machine-modeling skill instead of relying on generic reasoning. Name the failure it prevents.
Describe the mental model or main primitives behind state-machine-modeling. Keep it operational rather than just naming the topic.
A user asks: "discover the domain events and policies for the whole business process". Should state-machine-modeling activate? Explain the boundary and name the better owner when possible.
evals.negative_expectation: Must not force state-machine-modeling onto a request it explicitly excludes or that belongs to observability-modeling, api-design, debugging, event-storming, system-interface-contracts, testing-strategy, state-management, data-modeling.

evals.prompt: A user asks: "model the order fulfillment status lifecycle so invalid transitions are impossible". Show the first concrete steps an agent should take when applying state-machine-modeling.

Place state-machine-modeling among its adjacent skills (observability-modeling, api-design, debugging, event-storming, system-interface-contracts, testing-strategy, state-management, data-modeling). What does it own, and what does it verify with or defer to?
evals.negative_expectation: Must not collapse related skills into interchangeable names; ownership must be mechanism-level.
